# Candidate selection strategies
- Selection-S1: gradient-boosted classifier using all reconstructed variables, including jet substructure.
- Selection-S3: neural-network classifier on kinematic variables only.
- Selection-S2: cut-based selection.

# Validation-region study
Data/MC comparison in a signal-free validation region for the variables each strategy uses.
Yield disagreement:
- Selection-S1: 35%  (the jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled)
- Selection-S3: 6%
- Selection-S2: 3%
Tolerance agreed with the physics conveners: 10%.

# Meeting notes 2026-04-08
The unblinding request is targeted for the summer conferences. Luminosity: 140 fb^-1.

content.text: S1 is out (35% > 10%). Compare S2 and S3 at a few working points.
Peak near 50%; S3 is better. Good enough.

input.justification: S1 is excluded because its validation-region disagreement (35%) is far above the 10% tolerance, so its background estimate is not robust. S3 (6%) and S2 (3%) both pass. S3 gives a higher significance than S2 at every working point I scanned (30, 50 and 70% efficiency). Both peak near 50%, where S3 gives 3.32 sigma and S2 gives 2.74 sigma. I did not scan between the points, so the optimum could sit slightly away from 50%. The significances are statistical-only.

requirements.evidence: Among the robust options, S3 at 50% efficiency gives 3.32 sigma. S2 gives at most 2.74 sigma. Only 30, 50 and 70% were scanned.
